statement.zh: **标准**：开发网络弹性系统：系统安全工程方法（SP 800-160 第二卷）（Developing Cyber Resilient Systems: A Systems Security Engineering Approach (SP 800-160 Vol.摘要首句把它放进已有文件：「This publication is used in conjunction with ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2015」，并自陈体裁：「It can be viewed as a handbook for achieving the identified cyber resiliency outcomes based on a systems engineering perspective on system life cycle processes in conjunction with risk management processes, allowing the experience and expertise of the organization to help determine what is correct for its purpose.」§1.1 说明其补位性质：「The purpose of this document is to supplement [SP 800-160 v1] and [SP 800-37]」。
statement.en: **Standard**: Developing Cyber Resilient Systems: A Systems Security Engineering Approach (SP 800-160 Vol.2) (开发网络弹性系统：系统安全工程方法（SP 800-160 第二卷）).

statement.zh: 风险前提写在卷首综述：「All discussions of cyber resiliency focus on assuring the mission or business functions and are predicated on the assumption that the adversary will breach defenses and establish a long-term presence in organizational systems.」要得到的能力定义为「the ability to anticipate, withstand, recover from, and adapt to adverse conditions, stresses, attacks, or compromises on systems that use or are enabled by cyber resources」。摘要据此说明组织须自行取舍：「Organizations can select, adapt, and use some or all of the cyber resiliency constructs」。前提与能力并列即是理由：若对手必然进入并长期驻留，只防一次突破并不足以保证任务，弹性构念正是为此列出，且须由组织自行取舍。
statement.en: The premise sits in the front-matter overview: "All discussions of cyber resiliency focus on assuring the mission or business functions and are predicated on the assumption that the adversary will breach defenses and establish a long-term presence in organizational systems." The property sought is "the ability to anticipate, withstand, recover from, and adapt to adverse conditions, stresses, attacks, or compromises on systems that use or are enabled by cyber resources", and the abstract draws the consequence for the reader: "Organizations can select, adapt, and use some or all of the cyber resiliency constructs".

statement.zh: 开发网络弹性系统：系统安全工程方法（SP 800-160 第二卷）的used见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: Check the input, key or parameters and output format first, then locate the object in its protocol, standard or engineering workflow; do not treat one example parameter set as the only legal set.

statement.zh: 它自陈不提供步骤手册：卷首使用说明写「It is not intended to provide a specific recipe for execution.」并自比为手册：「it can be viewed as a catalog or handbook for achieving the identified cyber resiliency outcomes」。范围之外另有声明：「Second-order effects are beyond the scope of this publication.」强制力也有限：前言的法定职责段规定「Such information security standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of the appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems.」。最后，这份副本本身已被撤下，见 history 一节。
statement.en: It declines to be a procedure manual: the front-matter usage note says "It is not intended to provide a specific recipe for execution." and offers itself as "it can be viewed as a catalog or handbook for achieving the identified cyber resiliency outcomes".Part of the subject is excluded outright: "Second-order effects are beyond the scope of this publication." The force is limited too — the authority paragraph states that "Such information security standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of the appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems.".

statement.zh: 扉页三行给「NIST Special Publication 800-160」与「Developing Cyber Resilient Systems」，作者行为「RON ROSS VICTORIA PILLITTERI RICHARD GRAUBART DEBORAH BODEAU ROSALIE MCQUAID」；日期行 2019 年 11 月，引用行「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-160, Volume 2, 229 pages (November 2019)」，免费获取行后接 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-160v2。顶部废止横幅写「The attached publication has been withdrawn (archived), and is provided solely for historical purposes.」并记「SP 800-160 Vol.2 is superseded in its entirety by the publication of SP 800-160 Vol.2 Revision 1.」，取代件为 2021 年 12 月出版的 Vol.2 Revision 1，其 DOI 为 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-160v2r1。
statement.en: The title block carries "NIST Special Publication 800-160" and "Developing Cyber Resilient Systems", with the author line "RON ROSS VICTORIA PILLITTERI RICHARD GRAUBART DEBORAH BODEAU ROSALIE MCQUAID"; the date line is November 2019, the citation reads "Natl.Inst.
